note: zero-compute: re-reads deposited files only; every input is hashed under inputs

conventions.a_A: volume-equivalent conventional a = (Z V_prim)^(1/3); Z = 1 perovskite, 2 bcc, 4 fluorite; equals the length-based value while the cell stays cubic
conventions.primary_source: dft/geom/checks relaxed_prim_cell where present (the cells the DFT checks and pl_lattice.csv used), else the mean of the sscha_converged_grid run.relaxed_cellpar over temperatures
conventions.cubic_preserved: max |angle - ideal| <= 0.05 deg and (max-min)/mean primitive length <= 0.001; models failing it are excluded from the spread
conventions.start_value_unsourced: mlip_dynstab/systems.py LATTICE_A: unsourced starting value of the relaxation, NOT an experimental lattice

pbe.method: QE vc-relax, PBE, SSSP 1.3.0 efficiency (dft_checks.py stage pbe-lattice)
QE vc-relax, PBE, SSSP 1.3.0 efficiency (dft_checks.py stage pbe-lattice)
QE vc-relax, PBE, SSSP 1.3.0 efficiency (dft_checks.py stage pbe-lattice)

conventions.s: d ln X / d ln a from a two-point pair: ln(X1/X0) / ln(a1/a0); per ln V = s/3
conventions.depth_grid: the reported depth: -min over the sampled Q grid (dft_reference._curve_metrics, finite_t well_depth_meV)
conventions.kappa2, kappa4, kappa6: a, b, c of finite_t._fit_double_well: V(Q) = a Q^2 + b Q^4 + c Q^6 (eV, Q in Ang), least squares over the window dE <= min + max(0.06 eV, 5 depth); quartic refit if the sextic is not bounded
conventions.depth_fit_exact: exact minimum of the fitted polynomial over Q >= 0

decomposition.remainder_is: ln[(D_grid/D_quartic) at MLIP lattice / (D_grid/D_quartic) at PBE lattice]: grid placement + fit residual + sextic term

batio3_cubic.confound: lattice AND eigenvector change together: the PBE-lattice curve runs along PBE's own eigenvector (prof_meta m_eff), the MLIP-lattice curve along mace_mp0's eigenvector (pattern m_eff); same q and band, different force constants. s is therefore an upper-level total, not a pure lattice derivative
